# WebGL bindings

`assets/gles_bindings.js` from [flutter_angle](https://github.com/Knightro63/flutter_angle/tree/f2d4ba8579c8ab41864446785a5959c4d469a56b), commit `f2d4ba8579c8ab41864446785a5959c4d469a56b`, used by flutter_angle 0.4.2. Only trailing whitespace is normalized. Its MIT licence is included. The browser loads this local copy before Flutter; no runtime CDN dependency is required.
